title: Base ListServices variant 2
purpose: Vary a meaningful pair of encapsulation header fields in a discovery request while preserving the standard zero-length request shape and operation diversity.
expected_behavior: Parser handles a discovery request with a canonical header form while still traversing status/options field handling paths distinct from the default all-zero header.
constraints_preserved: Prefer EtherNet/IP encapsulation headers with little-endian payload length
Use a 24-byte encapsulation header when that form is selected
Diversify discovery, session and explicit-message paths
issue_safety_notes: Header field variation is conservative and intended for parser interaction coverage rather than claiming normative semantics. Model-prior only, with no external issue or protocol source.
